title: Co-Scientist: genetic factors to rejuvenate cells
summary: Omar Abudayyeh and Jonathan Gootenberg used Co-Scientist to search tens of thousands of papers, obtaining over 20 proposed genetic factors for reversing cellular aging, a couple of which were validated in the lab, and reducing analysis of genetic-screening data from six months to a few days. The post gives no sample size or peer review status.

evidence.tested: Lab tests validated a couple of the more than 20 proposed genetic factors, which pushed cells toward a younger state; the experiments and exact number are not described.
evidence.unknown: Not reported (the post gives no sample size or peer-review status and contains only the investigators' quotes).
evidence.ai_role: Co-Scientist scanned tens of thousands of papers, proposed genetic factors for reversing cellular aging and analysed screening data alongside the literature.
